rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR UPPER EXTREMITY CT / Upper Extremity Pain (1,2) / Special Notes
rules.source_quote: X-rays must precede CT evaluation, unless otherwise indicated
rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: Upper Extremity CT (Shoulder, Elbow, Wrist, Hand)

criteria.description: Upper extremity plain X-ray completed showing no definitive diagnostic etiology for joint/extremity pain
Persistent pain unresponsive to at least 4 weeks of active conservative therapy, OR acute complex fracture/arthrogram planning

required_documentation: Plain radiograph report and clinical orthopedic exam notes detailing pain localization and conservative treatment
rules.review_notes: Upper extremity CT requires preceding plain X-ray and conservative therapy unless acute fracture/surgical planning.
